proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8209 pibati gives the widespread pi-/piy- “drink” verb. Ordinary piyo/piye inflections fit; pī-lo can include the take light verb, and pī-ryo a progressive construction, so these need full-predicate analysis. Reviewed comparator: H piyo “drink!” (f_xpcv75shnq3ye). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9321 *bōll gives regional bol-/boḷ- “speak” and distinguishes a separate causative. The simple imperative/past bolal/bolau variants support this speak family; initial y in yolā needs a local sound account. Reviewed comparator: Marw bol “speak!, he spoke” (f_hkmfa7k24leq6). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
